finite_default_domain.definition: Blank odd square inputs of every native size 3 through 29: 14.
finite_default_domain.scope: Default native parameter distribution only; finite input count is not inflated by repeated sampling.

provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: The family consists of blank odd-sized square grids (background original colour 0, here palette[0]); the output paints every even-indexed row and every even-indexed column with original colour 1 (palette[1]), leaving single background holes at (odd,odd) positions. Because the size is always odd, even indices counted from either edge coincide, so the lattice is invariant under all eight D4 transforms; the emitted program therefore paints rows 0,2,4,... and columns 0,2,4,... directly in visible coordinates with the specialized line colour palette[1], keeping all other cells at the input's background value.
draft_notes.limitations: Assumes the constructor's domain: blank odd-sized square grids (3..29). For even-sized or rectangular grids with an even dimension the parity anchor (top-left) would be ambiguous under D4, but such grids never occur in this generator. The line colour is fixed to palette[1] rather than inferred from demonstrations.
